faqs.question: What is WhatsApp Business API, and how is it different from the WhatsApp Business App?
faqs.answer:
• The WhatsApp Business API, also known as the WhatsApp Business Platform, helps businesses automate customer conversations, send bulk messages, and manage support at scale.
  • Unlike the regular WhatsApp Business App, it supports AI chatbots, CRM integrations, automated campaigns, and multiple agents managing conversations from one platform.
  • And you don't need to be a developer to use it. With MSG91, businesses can set up their WhatsApp channel, create campaigns, build chatbots, and manage customer enquiries through a simple, no-code dashboard.
  • MSG91 makes WhatsApp automation easier with no-code campaign tools, chatbots, and a shared support inbox. Trusted by 30,000+ businesses globally, MSG91 helps you manage customer conversations as your business grows.
  • Explore the WhatsApp Coexistence setup guide.

faqs.question: What is WhatsApp Message pricing in India, and are there any hidden charges?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business Message pricing in India has two parts: Meta's messaging charges and the MSG91 platform fee. MSG91 adds zero markup to Meta's messaging rates, so you don't pay an additional provider margin on every message.
  • The published India rates are:
    • Marketing: ₹0.8631 per message
    • Utility: ₹0.115 per message
    • Authentication (OTP): ₹0.115 per message
    • Service: ₹0.115 per billable message after the free allowance
  • The MSG91 WhatsApp plan costs ₹500 per month per WhatsApp number, with the initial two months free. Applicable GST is additional.
  • For example, sending 10,000 billable marketing messages costs ₹8,631 before GST and platform fees.
  • There is no additional MSG91 markup on WhatsApp message rates. Platform fees, taxes, and any separately selected services are charged as applicable.
  • Explore MSG91 WhatsApp Business Message pricing in India.

faqs.question: What changed in WhatsApp Business pricing in October 2026?
faqs.answer:
• Imagine your support team answering hundreds of customer messages every day. Until recently, many of those replies were free. From October 1, 2026, Meta started charging for service messages sent through WhatsApp Business.
  • The first 1,000 eligible service messages per business phone number remain free each month. After that, businesses in India pay ₹0.115 per billable service message.
  • Utility templates sent during an active 24-hour customer service window also became chargeable, subject to Meta's free-entry-point exceptions.
  • For businesses handling lengthy customer conversations, these changes make every unnecessary WhatsApp reply an additional expense.
  • The Solution: MSG91 Chat Window. Start on WhatsApp and continue seamlessly on Chat Window without per-message WhatsApp service charges.
  • WhatsApp → Chat Window → Hello
  • AI chatbots and human agents can continue assisting customers without generating additional Meta WhatsApp messaging charges for messages exchanged inside Chat Window. Messages sent through WhatsApp remain subject to applicable rates.
  • The result? More control over messaging costs without cutting customer conversations short.
  • Read How Customer Support Changes With MSG91 Chat Window to learn how it works.

faqs.question: How does MSG91 Chat Window help businesses reduce WhatsApp customer support costs?
faqs.answer:
• A customer asks about an order on WhatsApp. Your agent replies, the customer asks another question, and the conversation continues. Under Meta's updated pricing, those additional WhatsApp replies can increase your support costs.
  • MSG91 Chat Window offers a simpler alternative: WhatsApp → Chat Window → Hello.
  • The customer receives a WhatsApp message with a chat link. Once they open it, the conversation continues in a dedicated Chat Window, while your team manages it through MSG91 Hello.
  • AI chatbots, rule-based bots, and human agents can keep assisting customers without sending every reply through WhatsApp.
  • Messages exchanged inside Chat Window do not incur Meta's WhatsApp message charges. Messages actually sent through WhatsApp remain subject to applicable rates.
  • Follow the MSG91 Chat Window setup guide to get started.

faqs.question: How can businesses get the WhatsApp blue tick verification badge?
faqs.answer:
• A verification badge helps customers recognise an authentic business. The badge commonly known as the green tick is now displayed as a blue verification badge in supported WhatsApp experiences.
  • Meta decides which businesses qualify, and no WhatsApp Business service provider can guarantee approval. Businesses can improve their readiness by completing the required verification, maintaining accurate business information, and following Meta's eligibility requirements. Official Business Account verification and Meta Verified are separate programmes with different conditions.
  • MSG91 provides guidance to help businesses understand the process and prepare their accounts. Read the MSG91 WhatsApp verification guide.

faqs.question: Can WhatsApp Business numbers get blocked, and how many messages can businesses send?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. Sending thousands of messages is useful only when customers actually want to receive them.
  • Meta can restrict WhatsApp numbers for spam complaints, policy violations, or poor messaging quality. Business-initiated messaging limits also depend on account eligibility and quality. New business portfolios may initially have a limit of 250 unique recipients within a rolling 24-hour period, with higher limits available as Meta's requirements are met.
  • To protect your number, send messages to opted-in customers, use approved templates, and monitor your account quality through WhatsApp Manager.
  • MSG91's WhatsApp account safety guide explains how to prevent and resolve common restrictions.

faqs.question: Is customer data secure with MSG91 WhatsApp?
faqs.answer:

  • MSG91 maintains documented information-security controls and provides a SOC 2 Type 2 audit report covering relevant security, availability, and confidentiality controls. Businesses can review the MSG91 SOC 2 Type 2 report.
  • MSG91 provides a robust permission management system to ensure customer data is accessible only to authorised users. We also offer S3 file storage, allowing you to retain control over your customers' files. MSG91 stores Indian users' data in Indian data centers for enhanced security.
